artists.name: Alvan Kimani
artists.bio: A contemporary painter inspired by nature, culture and everyday life.

artists.name: Lucia Caminos
artists.bio: Blending classical techniques with bold, layered acrylics to capture emotion and everyday beauty.

artists.name: Yvonne Muriuki
artists.bio: An artist creating minimalist and modern pieces for contemporary spaces.

artworks.title: The Glass Archipelago
artworks.description: An abstract representation of peaceful landscapes and distant horizons.

artworks.title: Concrete Bloom
artworks.description: A brutalist concrete monolith cracked down the middle, with delicate, hyper-realistic porcelain orchids growing out of the fissures.

artworks.title: Static in the Static
artworks.description: A large-scale mixed-media collage constructed entirely from shredded vintage newspapers, old cassette tape ribbons, and gold leaf.

artworks.title: Digital Reliquary
artworks.description: A woven tapestry made from salvaged fishing nets, driftwood, and dyed merino wool, charting the coastline of a disappearing island.

artworks.title: The Weight of Shadows
artworks.description: A large-scale mixed-media collage constructed entirely from shredded vintage newspapers, old cassette tape ribbons, and gold leaf.

artworks.title: Chromatic Echoes
artworks.description: A kinetic light installation featuring rotating prism lenses that project shifting, overlapping rainbows across a dark, mirrored room

artworks.title: Rust and Velvet
artworks.description: A heavily textured impasto painting combining oxidized iron paint and deep crimson pigment to evoke the decaying interior of an abandoned theater.

artworks.title: Suburban Mirage
artworks.description: A surrealist acrylic piece showing a row of identical mid-century houses melting seamlessly into a vast, sunlit desert landscape

artworks.title: The Spotlight
artworks.description: A minimalist bronze cast of an empty rocking chair tilted slightly backward as if someone just stood up.

reviews.comment: Beautiful artwork. The colours and details are amazing.
